page.layout: One column of verse-like running text, set in italic, full width, with a running head at the top centre; no margin notes; a short line "Delitiis" at the right below the last line (catchword).

main_text.l: Sed vero quia vita patrum me simplice cultu
In primis capit, & dulci succendit amore,
Hoc Voto pia Musa bonos venerabere agrestes,
Tantisper dum longe alios tibi molior orsus.
En plectrum & citharam paulum quoque rustica poscunt
Ipsa sibi & nostri montes. Hic ergo, priorum
Quem non parca olim contenta fidelibus aruis,
Nec patiens operum delectat vita per agros,
Haud ignara sitim sedare sonante fluento,
Suetaque decussis ieiunia soluere cornis:
Non hic lautitias urbis Salmontica vina:
Sed nec multiplici mensas sub lance gementes
Hic poscat, nimiaque dapes roget arte paratas.
At tibi quem capiunt agrorum cultus & horti:
Quem montes quem rura iuuant, rurisque suppellex
Lutea, delitias agri expectare salubres
Hic liceat; vescos fructus, olerumque feraces
Areolas, centum excipiant quae Pythagoreos.
Hic pernas sale duratas, sapidoque rubentes
Fumo, quae media duris sunt salgama Bruma
Monticolis, hic cocta cado tibi defruta aheno:
Cymbiaque hic pingui spumantia flumine lactis,
Et vivos latices (nite mage dura picatis
Horna cadis, neu te capiant hortensia vina
Quae tibi proventu det fertilis vbere malus)
Atque super viridi lachrymosa coagula iunco,
Quum tellus sitiens languentibus aestuat herbis,
Expectare iuuet. Nos hic agreste paratu
(Sed quem mundities, sed quem sua gratia condit)
Frugales epulis mensas oneramus inemptis,
Quales campus alit. Quicunque huc ergo palato
Solicito accedes, nostro expectabis in orbe
Non plura his, imo potius queis rustica patrum
Vita placet, vernis agri purisque volentes

page.notes: Pages uses italic throughout. "Delitiis" at the foot right is a catchword. Some words doubtful: "Horna" (line "Horna cadis") and "Quem"/"rura" readings; "Salmontica" and "Bruma" are as printed in the scan, unverified. Marked-up words were not individually checked against a higher-resolution image. Long s rendered as s throughout. Greek/Hebrew: none on this page.
